text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити talks with Тамамо Кросс
before the
Takarazuka Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Once again, Тамамо Кросс asks why
Gold City
runs. This time, Голд Сити
admits she has no real
answer other than
the simple desire to run and
win.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And for Голд Сити, that's good enough.
She heads
off to the race in high spirits!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
